Name: Boom
Round_Event: Each player with 🎲 ≥ 5 gains 2 🔷. Each player with 🎲 ≤ 3 gains 1 🔷 and 1 🎲.

Name: Drought
Round_Event: The player with the highest 🎲 loses 1 🎲. That 🎲 migrates clockwise to their neighbor (continues CW if receiver is at max 6).

Name: Storm
Round_Event: The player with the highest 🎲 loses 2 🎲. 1 migrates clockwise and 1 counterclockwise (each continues in same direction if receiver at max 6). Each player who receives a migrant gains 1 🔷.

Name: Reckoning
Round_Event: The player with the lowest 🎲 gains 1 🎲 (tie: starting harvester decides).
